name: Submission Web
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as web, except all creatures within the web takes 1d6 electricity damage at the beginning of their turn. A successful Reflex save halves this damage. On a failed Reflex save, the affected creature must make a Fortitude save or be stunned for 1 round.
